description: Batch sizes of the KernelBench level 2 problem 99 module (nn.Linear(8192, 8192), GELU, softmax over the features). The original cases escalated the batch from 256 to 4096; the performance cases extend it down to 32 (32 to 4096, 128x). Every batch reads the 256 MiB weight, so even batch 32 stays far above the 10 us floor. Batches 1, 3, 100 and 1000 are correctness-only boundary shapes, covering each block-size bucket of the baseline.
